description: A preset that asks for what a later phase brings gets the same warning as a file that asks for it. The preset energy turns cache.enabled on when a disk has the role cache, and the SSD cache is phase 2b's; it also sets new_files and colocate, which phase 2b brought, and replicas and mode, which need none: those get no warning. The role cache gets its own warning, from the file.
config:
strategy = "energy"
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[[disk]]
id = "c1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/c1"
fs = "ext4"
role = "cache"
